svg.aria-label: Row one: C4 (lower voice, circle) then E4 (upper voice, square), one after the other. Row two: E4 above C4 in one slot, played together. No interval name is shown.
svg.title: One after another, and together

g.text: Two ways to play the same two
How to read this graphic: In the first row,
read left to right: the lower note first,
then the upper note. In the second row the
two notes share one slot: the square (upper)
sits above the circle (lower) because they
sound at the same moment. Try both on your
